"""Independent raw-source/tokenizer-only verification of the frozen selection."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from experiments.r4_integrated import public_qa_data as utility

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CACHE=ROOT/'.knowledge-cache/public_qa/squad2'
selection_path=CACHE/'selection-v1.json'
raw_path=CACHE/'train-v2.0.json'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
selection_sha=utility.file_hash(selection_path)
data=utility.load_selection(selection_path,selection_sha)
raw=json.loads(raw_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
exclusions=json.loads((CACHE/'selection-v1.exclusions.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert utility.file_hash(CACHE/'selection-v1.exclusions.json')==data['exclusions']['sha256']
tokenizer=Tokenizer.from_file(str(utility.TOKENIZER));tokenizer.no_truncation();tokenizer.no_padding()
assert utility.file_hash(utility.TOKENIZER)==data['tokenizer']['sha256']
source={};contexts=defaultdict(set);duplicate_groups=defaultdict(list)
for ai,article in enumerate(raw['data']):
 for pi,paragraph in enumerate(article['paragraphs']):
  context=paragraph['context'];ch=sha(context.encode());title=article['title']
  contexts[ch].add(title)
  for qi,qa in enumerate(paragraph['qas']):
   assert qa['id'] not in source
   source[qa['id']]=(title,ai,pi,qi,context,qa)
   duplicate_groups[(title,context,qa['question'])].append(qa)
assert len(source)==130319
excluded={r['id']:r for r in exclusions['records']}
assert len(excluded)==len(exclusions['records'])==18583
assert set(excluded)<=set(source)
assert dict(Counter(reason for r in excluded.values() for reason in r['reasons']))==data['summary']['exclusion_reason_counts']
duplicate_counts=Counter()
for group in duplicate_groups.values():
 if len(group)<2:continue
 labels={(q['is_impossible'],tuple(sorted({(a['text'],a['answer_start']) for a in q['answers']}))) for q in group}
 if len(labels)>1:
  for q in group: assert 'conflicting_same_article_context_question' in excluded[q['id']]['reasons'];duplicate_counts['conflicting']+=1
 else:
  ordered=sorted(group,key=lambda q:(sha(q['id'].encode()),q['id']))
  for q in ordered[1:]:assert 'duplicate_same_article_context_question' in excluded[q['id']]['reasons'];duplicate_counts['same_label']+=1
assert duplicate_counts=={'conflicting':76,'same_label':26}
assert not any(len(titles)>1 for titles in contexts.values())

pools=defaultdict(list)
for identifier,(title,*rest) in source.items():
 if identifier in excluded:continue
 qa=rest[-1];split='probe' if int(sha(title.encode()),16)%5==0 else 'train'
 pools[(split,qa['is_impossible'])].append(identifier)
for value in pools.values():value.sort(key=lambda identifier:(sha(identifier.encode()),identifier))
for split,quota in [('train',256),('probe',64)]:
 yes=pools[(split,False)][:3*quota];no=pools[(split,True)][:quota]
 expected=[identifier for i,negative in enumerate(no) for identifier in (*yes[3*i:3*i+3],negative)]
 assert [r['id'] for r in data[split]]==expected

encoded_inputs={};annotation_count=0;multi_answer_questions=0
gold_word_lengths=Counter();token_max=0;candidate_total=0
for split in ('train','probe'):
 for row in data[split]:
  title,ai,pi,qi,context,qa=source[row['id']]
  d=data['documents'][row['paragraph_id']]
  assert (d['article_title'],d['article_index'],d['paragraph_index'],d['context'],row['qa_index'],row['question'])==(title,ai,pi,context,qi,qa['question'])
  assert row['paragraph_id']==f'squad2-train-a{ai}-p{pi}'
  assert len(row['answers'])==len(qa['answers']) and row['is_impossible']==qa['is_impossible']
  for original,annotated in zip(qa['answers'],row['answers'],strict=True):
   assert all(annotated[k]==v for k,v in original.items())
  for text,word_key,token_key,record in [(context,'word_byte_spans','token_count',d),(qa['question'],'question_word_byte_spans','question_token_count',row)]:
   if text not in encoded_inputs:
    encoding=tokenizer.encode(text);assert len(encoding.ids)<=256
    word_matches=list(re.finditer(r'\w+',text))
    word_spans=[(len(text[:m.start()].encode()),len(text[:m.end()].encode())) for m in word_matches]
    subtokens=[(len(text[:a].encode()),len(text[:b].encode())) for (a,b),special in zip(encoding.offsets,encoding.special_tokens_mask,strict=True) if not special and a!=b]
    for a,b in word_spans:
     inside=[(x,y) for x,y in subtokens if x<b and y>a]
     assert inside and all(a<=x<y<=b for x,y in inside)
    encoded_inputs[text]=(word_spans,len(encoding.ids))
   spans,tokens=encoded_inputs[text];token_max=max(token_max,tokens)
   assert record[word_key]==[list(s) for s in spans] and record[token_key]==tokens
  starts={a:i for i,(a,_) in enumerate(encoded_inputs[context][0])};ends={b:i+1 for i,(_,b) in enumerate(encoded_inputs[context][0])}
  for ann in row['answers']:
   a=ann['answer_start'];b=a+len(ann['text']);left=len(context[:a].encode());right=len(context[:b].encode())
   assert context[a:b]==ann['text'] and (ann['byte_start'],ann['byte_end'])==(left,right)
   first,last=starts[left],ends[right]
   assert (ann['word_start'],ann['word_end'],ann['window_index'])==(first,last,first//48)
   assert first//48==(last-1)//48
   assert context.encode()[left:right]==ann['text'].encode()
   annotation_count+=1;gold_word_lengths[last-first]+=1
  multi_answer_questions+=len(row['answers'])>1
for d in data['documents'].values():
 n=len(d['word_byte_spans']);candidate_total+=sum(k*(k+1)//2 for k in [min(48,n-i) for i in range(0,n,48)])
assert candidate_total==data['cache_estimates']['all_selected_document_candidate_count_if_materialized']
assert sum(len(v[0]) for v in encoded_inputs.values())*384*8==data['cache_estimates']['word_vectors_float64_bytes']
train_ids={r['id'] for r in data['train']}
assert set(data['early_train_ids'])<=train_ids and set(data['late_train_ids'])<=train_ids
assert len(data['early_train_ids'])==len(data['late_train_ids'])==32
assert not set(data['early_train_ids'])&set(data['late_train_ids'])

for name,section in [('early_train_ids',data['train'][:256]),('late_train_ids',data['train'][-256:])]:
 chosen=[]
 for label,count in [(False,24),(True,8)]:

 assert set(chosen)==set(data[name]);retention_counts[name]={'supported':24,'STOP':8}

checks=[]
for text in ['Café has blue iris.','alpha beta gamma']:
 info=utility._token_info(tokenizer,text);assert not info['reasons'];checks.append('UTF8 whole-word pooling: '+text)
context='é alpha beta';info=utility._token_info(tokenizer,context)
qa={'is_impossible':False,'answers':[{'text':'alpha','answer_start':2},{'text':'beta','answer_start':8}]}
answers,reasons=utility._annotated_answers(context,qa,info);assert not reasons and len(answers)==2 and answers[0]['byte_start']==3
qa['answers'].append({'text':'alph','answer_start':2});assert 'answer_not_exact_word_boundaries' in utility._annotated_answers(context,qa,info)[1]
checks.append('all annotations preserved; one incompatible alternative rejects record')
context=' '.join(['word']*50);info=utility._token_info(tokenizer,context)
cross={'is_impossible':False,'answers':[{'text':'word word','answer_start':47*5}]}
assert 'answer_crosses_48_word_window' in utility._annotated_answers(context,cross,info)[1]
cross['answers'][0]['answer_start']=46*5;assert not utility._annotated_answers(context,cross,info)[1]
checks.append('exact 48-word window endpoint versus crossing')

checks.append('256-total-token limit includes special tokens')
assert utility._annotated_answers('word',{'is_impossible':True,'answers':[]},utility._token_info(tokenizer,'word'))==([],[])
assert 'unsupported_has_accepted_answers' in utility._annotated_answers('word',{'is_impossible':True,'answers':[{'text':'word','answer_start':0}]},utility._token_info(tokenizer,'word'))[1]
checks.append('STOP annotation scope and inconsistent-label rejection')
try:utility.load_selection(selection_path,'wrong');raise AssertionError('hash accepted')
except ValueError:pass

assert utility.file_hash(selection_path)==selection_sha
assert not any(k=='onnxruntime' or k.startswith('humanbrain.') for k in sys.modules)

"""Trainable conventional attention control with the existing span/STOP objective.

There is no recurrent state or simulated-cell claim. Shared token projection
gives q=tanh(W*x_query+b), d=tanh(W*x_document+b); attention is softmax(d*A*q.T/8),
c=attention*q, and h=tanh(F*[d;c]+b_f). Inputs retain their existing modality tags.
Only the unchanged read-only objective, prediction and identity helpers are
inherited. All producer and optimizer arrays below belong to this control.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from humanbrain.rate_cell_reader import RateCellReader, SpanInventory, TokenInput, _array_hash

PARAMETER_NAMES = (
    "input_weights",
    "input_bias",
    "attention_weights",
    "fusion_weights",
    "fusion_bias",
    "span_heads",
    "stop_head",
    "stop_bias",
)
POLICY = "conventional_feedforward_attention_word_span_hierarchical_stop_v1"


class ConventionalAttentionReader(RateCellReader):
    """Parameter-matched feedforward comparator; no invocation of the cell producer."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        mode: str = "trainable",
        seed: int = 0,
        learning_rate: float = 0.001,
        gradient_clip_norm: float = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        if mode not in ("trainable", "frozen"):
            raise ValueError("conventional reader mode must be trainable or frozen")
        if not np.isfinite(learning_rate) or learning_rate <= 0:
            raise ValueError("positive finite learning rate required")
        if not np.isfinite(gradient_clip_norm) or gradient_clip_norm <= 0:
            raise ValueError("positive finite gradient clip required")
        self.mode = mode
        self.learning_rate, self.gradient_clip_norm = learning_rate, gradient_clip_norm
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        self._weights = {
            "input_weights": rng.standard_normal((64, 386)) / np.sqrt(386),
            "input_bias": np.zeros(64),
            "attention_weights": np.eye(64),
            "fusion_weights": rng.standard_normal((64, 128)) / np.sqrt(128),
            "fusion_bias": np.zeros(64),
            "span_heads": rng.standard_normal((3, 64)) * (0.01 / np.sqrt(64)),
            "stop_head": rng.standard_normal(64) * (0.01 / np.sqrt(64)),
            "stop_bias": np.zeros(1),
        }
        self._first = {k: np.zeros_like(v) for k, v in self._weights.items()}
        self._second = {k: np.zeros_like(v) for k, v in self._weights.items()}
        self._steps = {k: 0 for k in PARAMETER_NAMES}
        self.offer_count = self.update_count = 0
        self.parameters = {
            "policy": POLICY,
            "mode": mode,
            "seed": seed,
            "hidden_dimension": 64,
            "parameter_count": sum(v.size for v in self._weights.values()),
            "parameter_names": PARAMETER_NAMES,
            "producer": "q=tanh(W*xq+b);d=tanh(W*xd+b);a=softmax(d*A*q.T/8);h=tanh(F*[d;a*q]+bf)",
            "initialization": (
                "default_rng(seed);draw W normal/sqrt386 then F normal/sqrt128 then "
                "span_heads normal*.01/sqrt64 then stop_head normal*.01/sqrt64;"
                "A=I64;input_bias=fusion_bias=stop_bias=0;no_other_draws"
            ),
            "empty_query": "zero context;empty attention;attention_weights gradient zero",
            "learning_rate": learning_rate,
            "gradient_clip_norm": gradient_clip_norm,
            "optimizer": "Adam;beta1=.9;beta2=.999;epsilon=1e-8;no_decay;per_parameter_steps",
            "mask": "STOP_skips_span_parameters_moments_steps;clip_active_coordinates_only",
            "gate_pool": "mean_all_document_word_states_token_weighted;exclude_query_padding",
            "inference": "p_stop>=.5_STOP;otherwise_unique_span_max;tie_STOP",
        }

    def checkpoint_arrays(self) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        arrays = {"weight_" + k: v.copy() for k, v in self._weights.items()}
        arrays.update({"adam_first_" + k: v.copy() for k, v in self._first.items()})
        arrays.update({"adam_second_" + k: v.copy() for k, v in self._second.items()})
        arrays["adam_steps"] = np.asarray([self._steps[k] for k in PARAMETER_NAMES], dtype=np.int64)
        return arrays

    def snapshot(self) -> dict:
        result = super().snapshot()
        result["allocated_optimizer_bytes"] = sum(
            v.nbytes for v in self._first.values()
        ) * 2 + 8 * len(PARAMETER_NAMES)
        return result

    def _forward(self, query: TokenInput, inventory: SpanInventory) -> dict:
        w = self._weights
        qx = np.zeros((len(query.vectors), 386))
        qx[:, :384], qx[:, 384] = query.vectors, 1
        count = sum(len(window.vectors) for window in inventory.windows)
        dx = np.zeros((count, 386))
        offset = 0
        for window in inventory.windows:
            end = offset + len(window.vectors)
            dx[offset:end, :384], dx[offset:end, 385] = window.vectors, 1
            offset = end
        q = np.tanh(qx @ w["input_weights"].T + w["input_bias"])
        d = np.tanh(dx @ w["input_weights"].T + w["input_bias"])
        if len(q):
            logits = (d @ w["attention_weights"] @ q.T) / 8.0
            exponentials = np.exp(logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True))
            attention = exponentials / exponentials.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        else:
            attention = np.zeros((count, 0))
        context = attention @ q
        fused = np.concatenate((d, context), axis=1)
        h = np.tanh(fused @ w["fusion_weights"].T + w["fusion_bias"])
        scores = np.empty(len(inventory.candidates))
        offset = 0
        for i, window in enumerate(inventory.windows):
            end_word = offset + len(window.vectors)
            heads = h[offset:end_word] @ w["span_heads"].T
            start, end = inventory.local_spans[i].T
            prefix = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(heads[:, 2])]
            begin, finish = inventory.window_candidate_ranges[i]
            scores[begin:finish] = (
                heads[start, 0] + heads[end - 1, 1] + (prefix[end] - prefix[start]) / (end - start)
            )
            offset = end_word
        pooled = h.sum(axis=0) / max(1, count)
        stop_logit = float(pooled @ w["stop_head"] + w["stop_bias"][0])
        p_stop = float(np.exp(-np.logaddexp(0.0, -stop_logit)))
        if not np.isfinite(scores).all() or not np.isfinite(stop_logit):
            raise ValueError("nonfinite conventional forward state")
        return {
            "query_input": qx,
            "document_input": dx,
            "query_projection": q,
            "document_projection": d,
            "attention": attention,
            "context": context,
            "fused": fused,
            "hidden": h,
            "scores": scores,
            "pooled": pooled,
            "stop_logit": stop_logit,
            "p_stop": p_stop,
            "document_count": count,
        }

    def loss_and_gradients(
        self, query: TokenInput, inventory: SpanInventory, gold_indices: tuple[int, ...] | None
    ) -> tuple[float, dict, dict]:
        f = self._forward(query, inventory)
        loss, gate_loss, span_loss, coefficients, gate_derivative = self._objective(f, gold_indices)
        w = self._weights
        gradient = {k: np.zeros_like(v) for k, v in w.items()}
        gradient["stop_head"] = gate_derivative * f["pooled"]
        gradient["stop_bias"][0] = gate_derivative
        dh = np.zeros_like(f["hidden"])
        offset = 0
        for i, window in enumerate(inventory.windows):
            count = len(window.vectors)
            h = f["hidden"][offset : offset + count]
            start, end = inventory.local_spans[i].T
            begin, finish = inventory.window_candidate_ranges[i]
            coef = coefficients[begin:finish]
            start_weight, end_weight = np.zeros(count), np.zeros(count)
            np.add.at(start_weight, start, coef)
            np.add.at(end_weight, end - 1, coef)
            difference = np.zeros(count + 1)
            middle = coef / (end - start)
            np.add.at(difference, start, middle)
            np.add.at(difference, end, -middle)
            weights = np.stack((start_weight, end_weight, np.cumsum(difference)[:-1]))
            gradient["span_heads"] += weights @ h
            dh[offset : offset + count] = weights.T @ w["span_heads"] + gate_derivative * w[
                "stop_head"
            ] / max(1, f["document_count"])
            offset += count
        delta = dh * (1 - f["hidden"] ** 2)
        gradient["fusion_weights"] = delta.T @ f["fused"]
        gradient["fusion_bias"] = delta.sum(axis=0)
        dfused = delta @ w["fusion_weights"]
        dd, dc = dfused[:, :64], dfused[:, 64:]
        q, d = f["query_projection"], f["document_projection"]
        da = dc @ q.T
        ds = f["attention"] * (da - (da * f["attention"]).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
        gradient["attention_weights"] = d.T @ ds @ q / 8.0
        dd += ds @ q @ w["attention_weights"].T / 8.0
        dq = f["attention"].T @ dc + ds.T @ d @ w["attention_weights"] / 8.0
        dquery = dq * (1 - q**2)
        ddocument = dd * (1 - d**2)
        gradient["input_weights"] = dquery.T @ f["query_input"] + ddocument.T @ f["document_input"]
        gradient["input_bias"] = dquery.sum(axis=0) + ddocument.sum(axis=0)
        if not np.isfinite(loss) or any(not np.isfinite(g).all() for g in gradient.values()):
            raise ValueError("nonfinite conventional objective or gradient")
        audit = {
            "loss": loss,
            "gate_loss": gate_loss,
            "span_loss": span_loss,
            "stop_logit": f["stop_logit"],
            "p_stop": f["p_stop"],
            "scores_sha256": _array_hash(f["scores"]),
            "document_word_count": f["document_count"],
            "recurrent_cell_steps": 0,
            "feedforward_hidden_activations": 64 * (len(q) + 2 * len(d)),
            "trajectory_array_bytes": 0,
            "input_array_bytes": f["query_input"].nbytes + f["document_input"].nbytes,
            "producer_array_bytes": sum(
                f[k].nbytes
                for k in (
                    "query_projection",
                    "document_projection",
                    "attention",
                    "context",
                    "fused",
                    "hidden",
                )
            ),
            "span_score_array_bytes": f["scores"].nbytes,
            "attention_entries": f["attention"].size,
            "attention_sha256": _array_hash(f["attention"]),
        }
        return float(loss), gradient, audit

    def observe(
        self, query: TokenInput, inventory: SpanInventory, gold_indices: tuple[int, ...] | None
    ) -> dict:
        # Same frozen Adam arithmetic, using this comparator's actual parameters.
        before = self.checkpoint_sha256
        _, gradients, audit = self.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold_indices)
        active = (
            []
            if self.mode == "frozen"
            else [k for k in PARAMETER_NAMES if not (gold_indices is None and k == "span_heads")]
        )
        norm = float(np.sqrt(sum(float(np.sum(gradients[k] ** 2)) for k in active)))
        if not np.isfinite(norm):
            raise ValueError("nonfinite active gradient norm; no state published")
        scale = min(1.0, self.gradient_clip_norm / norm) if norm else 1.0
        steps_before, proposed = dict(self._steps), {}
        for k in active:
            g = gradients[k] * scale
            step = self._steps[k] + 1
            first = 0.9 * self._first[k] + 0.1 * g
            second = 0.999 * self._second[k] + 0.001 * (g * g)
            corrected_first = first / (1 - 0.9**step)
            corrected_second = second / (1 - 0.999**step)
            weight = self._weights[k] - self.learning_rate * corrected_first / (
                np.sqrt(corrected_second) + 1e-8
            )
            if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (first, second, weight)):
                raise ValueError("nonfinite Adam proposal; no state published")
            proposed[k] = (weight, first, second, step)
        changed = any(
            not np.array_equal(self._weights[k], value[0]) for k, value in proposed.items()
        )
        for k, (weight, first, second, step) in proposed.items():
            self._weights[k], self._first[k], self._second[k], self._steps[k] = (
                weight,
                first,
                second,
                step,
            )
        self.offer_count += 1
        self.update_count += int(changed)
        after_loss, after_gate, after_span, _, _ = self._objective(
            self._forward(query, inventory), gold_indices
        )
        return {
            "mode": self.mode,
            "before": before,
            "after": self.checkpoint_sha256,
            "query_sha256": query.sha256,
            "inventory_sha256": inventory.sha256,
            "gold_indices": None if gold_indices is None else list(gold_indices),
            "before_objective": audit,
            "loss_after": after_loss,
            "gate_loss_after": after_gate,
            "span_loss_after": after_span,
            "gradient_sha256": {k: _array_hash(v) for k, v in gradients.items()},
            "active_parameters": active,
            "gradient_norm": norm,
            "clip_scale": scale,
            "adam_steps_before": steps_before,
            "adam_steps_after": dict(self._steps),
            "parameter_update_applied": changed,
            "native_update_applied": False,
            "offer_count": self.offer_count,
            "update_count": self.update_count,
        }

def _synthetic_extractive_reader(score=None):
    """Real tiny pair tokenizer, fake graph logits; no pretrained inference."""
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer, models, pre_tokenizers, processors

    from humanbrain.frozen_extractive_reader import FrozenExtractiveReader

    words = [
        "<s>",
        "<pad>",
        "</s>",
        "<unk>",
        "ask",
        "Café",
        "naïve",
        "blue-green,",
        "O'Brien",
    ]
    words += [f"w{i}" for i in range(700)]
    vocab = {word: i for i, word in enumerate(words)}
    tokenizer = Tokenizer(models.WordLevel(vocab, unk_token="<unk>"))
    tokenizer.pre_tokenizer = pre_tokenizers.WhitespaceSplit()
    tokenizer.post_processor = processors.RobertaProcessing(
        ("</s>", 2), ("<s>", 0), trim_offsets=False, add_prefix_space=False
    )

    class Session:
        def __init__(self):
            self.calls = []

        def run(self, names, inputs):
            assert names == ["start_logits", "end_logits"]
            assert set(inputs) == {"input_ids", "attention_mask"}
            assert all(x.dtype == np.int64 for x in inputs.values())
            ids = inputs["input_ids"][0]
            self.calls.append(ids.copy())
            logits = np.full((2, 1, len(ids)), -10.0, dtype=np.float32)
            logits[:, 0, 0] = 0
            if score:
                score(ids, logits, vocab)
            return list(logits)

    reader = FrozenExtractiveReader.__new__(FrozenExtractiveReader)
    reader._pair_processor = tokenizer.post_processor
    tokenizer.post_processor = None
    reader._tokenizer = tokenizer
    reader._session = Session()
    reader.sha256 = "synthetic-reader"
    return reader


def test_extractive_reader_preserves_full_utf8_span_and_masks_question():

        logits[:, 0, ids == vocab["ask"]] = 1000  # Never a context answer.

    result = reader.read(b"ask", (OpaqueDocument(b"d", b"p", raw),))

    assert result.best_margin == 16
    assert result.selected.byte_start == 0 and result.selected.byte_end == len(raw)
    assert result.windows[0].legal_span_count == 8 * 9 // 2
    assert result.query_content_tokens == 1 and result.paired_tokens == 13

    assert reader.read(b"ask", (OpaqueDocument(b"d", b"p", raw),)).emitted == raw


def test_extractive_reader_byte_level_offsets_include_combining_characters():
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer, models, pre_tokenizers, processors

    symbols = ["<s>", "<pad>", "</s>", "<unk>", *sorted(pre_tokenizers.ByteLevel.alphabet())]
    tokenizer = Tokenizer(models.BPE({s: i for i, s in enumerate(symbols)}, [], unk_token="<unk>"))
    tokenizer.pre_tokenizer = pre_tokenizers.ByteLevel(add_prefix_space=False)
    tokenizer.post_processor = processors.RobertaProcessing(
        ("</s>", 2), ("<s>", 0), trim_offsets=True, add_prefix_space=False
    )
    reader = _synthetic_extractive_reader()
    raw = "prefix Café Cafe\u0301 suffix".encode()
    text = raw.decode()
    pair = tokenizer.encode("ask", text)
    reader._pair_processor = tokenizer.post_processor
    tokenizer.post_processor = None
    reader._tokenizer = tokenizer
    left, right = text.index("Café"), text.index(" suffix")
    starts = [
        i
        for i, (a, b) in enumerate(pair.offsets)
        if pair.sequence_ids[i] == 1 and a == left and b > a
    ]
    ends = [
        i
        for i, (a, b) in enumerate(pair.offsets)
        if pair.sequence_ids[i] == 1 and b == right and b > a
    ]

    def run(names, inputs):
        logits = np.full((2, 1, len(pair.ids)), -10, dtype=np.float32)
        logits[:, 0, 0] = 0
        logits[0, 0, starts] = 10
        logits[1, 0, ends] = 10
        return list(logits)

    reader._session.run = run
    before = tokenizer.to_str()
    result = reader.read(b"ask", (OpaqueDocument(b"d", b"p", raw),))
    assert result.emitted == "Café Cafe\u0301".encode()

    reader._session.run = lambda names, inputs: [np.zeros((1, 1))] * 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="malformed"):

    )

        memory.ingest((appended,))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exactly one retained occurrence"):
        update.decision_for_span(query, b"23")
    # Exercise another real update after append, before revisiting either side.
    intervening = update.decision_for_span(b"How many does Birch send?", b"31")
    yoked = frozen.replay_decision(intervening)
    assert update.observe_feedback(intervening, 1)["synaptic_update"]
    frozen.observe_feedback(yoked, 1)

    revisited = []
    for memory in (update, frozen):
        before = memory.checkpoint_sha256
        summary = memory.storage_summary
        pair = tuple(memory.revisit_decision(row) for row in (rejected, accepted))
        for old, current in zip((rejected, accepted), pair, strict=True):

        frozen.replay_decision(rejected)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="frozen synapses"):
        update.replay_decision(rejected)

    frozen_receipt = frozen.observe_comparison(*revisited[1])
    assert updated_receipt["eligibility_delta_sha256"] == first["eligibility_delta_sha256"]
    assert frozen_receipt["eligibility_delta_sha256"] == first["eligibility_delta_sha256"]
    assert updated_receipt["native_update_applied"] == (updated_receipt["gap_before"] < 1)
    assert not frozen_receipt["synaptic_update"]
    assert frozen.synapse_sha256 == initial_frozen_synapses
    assert update.feedback_count == frozen.feedback_count == 5
    assert update.update_count == 2 + int(updated_receipt["native_update_applied"])
    assert frozen.update_count == 0

@pytest.mark.parametrize("learning_rate", (0.001, 1.0))
@pytest.mark.parametrize("starting_gap", (-2.0, 0.0, 0.75))
def test_capped_comparison_native_step_matches_margin_arithmetic_and_frozen_exposure(
    encoder, learning_rate, starting_gap
) -> None:
    update = ContextualEvidenceMemory(
        encoder, learning_rate=learning_rate, candidate_interactions=True,
        comparison_step_policy="unit_margin_capped",
    )
    frozen = ContextualEvidenceMemory(
        encoder, learning_rate=learning_rate, candidate_interactions=True,
        comparison_step_policy="unit_margin_capped", learning_enabled=False,
    )
    for memory in (update, frozen):
        memory.ingest((document(),))
        memory._bias[0] = 0.25  # Persistent bias must not enter the pair calculation.
    assert update.checkpoint_sha256 == frozen.checkpoint_sha256
    query = "How many messages does Café receive?".encode()
    rejected = update.decision_for_span(query, b"23")
    accepted = update.decision_for_span(query, b"17")
    delta = np.asarray(accepted.eligibility) - np.asarray(rejected.eligibility)
    squared_norm = float(delta @ delta)
    initial_weights = starting_gap * delta / squared_norm
    for memory in (update, frozen):
        memory._weights[0] = initial_weights
    rejected = update.decision_for_span(query, b"23")
    accepted = update.decision_for_span(query, b"17")
    measured_gap = float(initial_weights @ delta)
    expected_rate = min(
        learning_rate, (1 - measured_gap) * np.sqrt(1 + squared_norm) / (2 * squared_norm)
    )
    expected_step = expected_rate / np.sqrt(1 + squared_norm)
    frozen_pair = tuple(frozen.replay_decision(d) for d in (rejected, accepted))
    frozen_sha = frozen.synapse_sha256
    receipt = update.observe_comparison(rejected, accepted)
    frozen_receipt = frozen.observe_comparison(*frozen_pair)
    json.dumps(receipt, allow_nan=False)
    json.dumps(frozen_receipt, allow_nan=False)
    arrays = update.checkpoint_arrays()
    np.testing.assert_allclose(
        arrays["readout_synapses_pa"][0], initial_weights + expected_step * delta, atol=1e-14
    )
    np.testing.assert_allclose(arrays["readout_synapses_pa"][1], -expected_step * delta, atol=1e-14)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(arrays["pacemaker_synapses_pa"], [0.25, 0])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(arrays["readout_synapses_pa"][:, :384], 0)
    assert receipt["eligibility_delta_norm_squared"] == squared_norm
    assert receipt["proposed_learning_rate"] == receipt["effective_learning_rate"] == expected_rate
    assert receipt["cap_active"] == (expected_rate < learning_rate)
    assert receipt["gap_before"] == pytest.approx(starting_gap, abs=1e-12)
    assert receipt["gap_after"] == pytest.approx(
        starting_gap + 2 * expected_step * squared_norm, abs=1e-12
    )
    assert receipt["gap_after"] <= 1 + 1e-12
    assert receipt["native_update_applied"] and receipt["synaptic_update"]
    assert receipt["comparison_step_policy"] == "unit_margin_capped"
    assert frozen_receipt["proposed_learning_rate"] == expected_rate
    assert frozen_receipt["effective_learning_rate"] == 0
    assert not frozen_receipt["native_update_applied"] and not frozen_receipt["synaptic_update"]
    assert frozen.synapse_sha256 == frozen_sha
    assert receipt["eligibility_delta_sha256"] == frozen_receipt["eligibility_delta_sha256"]
    assert update.feedback_count == frozen.feedback_count == 2
    assert update.update_count == 1 and frozen.update_count == 0
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stale parent"):
        update.observe_comparison(rejected, accepted)

class _SyntheticSpanEncoding:
    """Orthogonal word vectors for native plasticity tests; no pretrained model."""

    def __init__(self, raw: bytes):
        self.raw = raw
        self.sentence_vector = self.pool_spans(((0, len(raw)),))[0]

    def pool_spans(self, spans):
        vectors = np.zeros((len(spans), 384))
        vocabulary = {b"alpha": 0, b"beta": 1, b"gamma": 2, b"request": 3, b"another": 4}
        for row, (start, end) in zip(vectors, spans, strict=True):
            for word in self.raw[start:end].split():
                index = vocabulary.get(word, 5 + int.from_bytes(sha256(word).digest()[:2]) % 379)
                row[index] += 1.0
        return vectors


class _SyntheticProtectionEncoder:
    sha256 = sha256(b"synthetic-orthogonal-word-encoder-v1").hexdigest()

    def encode(self, raw):
        return _SyntheticSpanEncoding(raw)


def _protection_memory(**options):
    memory = ContextualEvidenceMemory(
        _SyntheticProtectionEncoder(),
        comparison_protection_policy="orthogonal_certified",
        **options,
    )
    memory.ingest((OpaqueDocument(b"synthetic", b"public-test", b"alpha beta gamma"),))
    return memory


def _protection_pair(memory, rejected=b"alpha", accepted=b"beta", query=b"request"):
    return tuple(memory.decision_for_span(query, word) for word in (rejected, accepted))


def test_protected_comparisons_preserve_raw_margins_and_original_normalizer() -> None:
    memory = _protection_memory()
    original_pair = _protection_pair(memory)
    first = memory.observe_comparison(*original_pair)
    d1 = np.asarray(original_pair[1].eligibility) - np.asarray(original_pair[0].eligibility)
    assert first["protection"]["consolidated"]
    assert first["protection"]["basis_after_rank"] == 1
    first_margin = first["gap_after"]
    pair = _protection_pair(memory, b"beta", b"gamma")
    d2 = np.asarray(pair[1].eligibility) - np.asarray(pair[0].eligibility)
    p = d2 - d1 * ((d1 @ d2) / (d1 @ d1))
    weights_before = memory._weights.copy()
    receipt = memory.observe_comparison(*pair)
    expected = p / np.sqrt(1 + d2 @ d2)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(memory._weights - weights_before, [expected, -expected], atol=1e-14)
    assert receipt["gap_after"] == pytest.approx(
        receipt["gap_before"] + 2 * (d2 @ p) / np.sqrt(1 + d2 @ d2), abs=1e-14
    )

    assert memory.protection_summary["protected_count"] == 1
    assert float((memory._weights[0] - memory._weights[1]) @ d1) == pytest.approx(first_margin)
    # The second authentic offer reaches the margin and alone can add direction two.
    next_receipt = memory.observe_comparison(*_protection_pair(memory, b"beta", b"gamma"))
    assert next_receipt["gap_after"] >= 1
    assert next_receipt["protection"]["basis_after_rank"] == 2
    assert next_receipt["protection"]["protected_margin_violations"] == 0
    np.testing.assert_allclose(
        memory._protection_basis @ memory._protection_basis.T, np.eye(2), atol=1e-14
    )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(memory._weights[:, :384], 0)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(memory._bias, 0)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(memory._eligibility, 0)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(memory._projected_eligibility, 0)

def test_full_choice_marginal_gradient_matches_finite_differences(gold) -> None:
    from humanbrain.full_choice_evidence_memory import full_choice_loss_gradient

    features = np.array([[1., 0., 2.], [0., 2., 1.], [1., -1., 0.], [-2., 0., 1.]])
    theta = np.array([0.2, -0.1, 0.3, -0.4])
    loss, gradient, logits = full_choice_loss_gradient(features, theta[:-1], theta[-1], gold)
    expected = np.log(np.exp(logits).sum()) - np.log(np.exp(logits[list(gold)]).sum())
    assert loss == pytest.approx(expected, abs=1e-14)
    numerical = np.empty(4)
    for i in range(4):
        positive, negative = theta.copy(), theta.copy()
        positive[i] += 1e-6
        negative[i] -= 1e-6
        numerical[i] = (
            full_choice_loss_gradient(features, positive[:-1], positive[-1], gold)[0]
            - full_choice_loss_gradient(features, negative[:-1], negative[-1], gold)[0]
        ) / 2e-6
    np.testing.assert_allclose(gradient, numerical, atol=1e-9, rtol=1e-9)
    # An unexecuted high-scoring competitor still enters the normalization.
    more = np.vstack((features, [8., -8., 8.]))
    extended_gold = (5,) if gold == (4,) else gold
    assert full_choice_loss_gradient(more, theta[:-1], theta[-1], extended_gold)[0] > loss

def test_rate_cell_manual_bptt_recurrent_and_head_finite_differences():
    from humanbrain.rate_cell_reader import RateCellReader

    query, inventory = _rate_cell_synthetic_inputs()
    model = RateCellReader()
    gold = inventory.gold_indices(b"quiet silver river")
    assert len(gold) == 2
    _, gradients, audit = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)
    assert audit["gate_loss"] > 0 and audit["span_loss"] > 0
    checks = {
        "input_weights": [(3, 19), (9, 384), (12, 385)],
        "recurrent_weights": [(2, 7), (8, 8)],
        "cell_bias": [(4,)],
        "span_heads": [(0, 5), (1, 13), (2, 19)],
        "stop_head": [(9,)], "stop_bias": [(0,)],
    }
    epsilon = 1e-6
    for name, coordinates in checks.items():
        for index in coordinates:
            original = model._weights[name][index]
            model._weights[name][index] = original + epsilon
            plus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights[name][index] = original - epsilon
            minus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights[name][index] = original
            assert gradients[name][index] == pytest.approx(
                (plus - minus) / (2 * epsilon), abs=2e-7, rel=2e-5)
    # A producer direction tests all recurrent coordinates together.

    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
        model._weights["span_heads"], rng.standard_normal((3, 64)) * (0.01 / np.sqrt(64))
    )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
        model._weights["stop_head"], rng.standard_normal(64) * (0.01 / np.sqrt(64))
    )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(model._weights["attention_weights"], np.eye(64))
    w = model._weights
    q = np.array(
        [np.tanh(w["input_weights"] @ np.r_[v, 1, 0] + w["input_bias"]) for v in query.vectors]
    )
    expected_scores, expected_states = [], []
    for window in inventory.windows:
        states = []
        for vector in window.vectors:
            d = np.tanh(w["input_weights"] @ np.r_[vector, 0, 1] + w["input_bias"])
            logits = np.array([d @ w["attention_weights"] @ u / 8 for u in q])
            probabilities = np.exp(logits - logits.max())
            probabilities /= probabilities.sum()
            h = np.tanh(w["fusion_weights"] @ np.r_[d, probabilities @ q] + w["fusion_bias"])
            states.append(h)
        states = np.array(states)
        expected_states.extend(states)
        for start in range(len(states)):
            for end in range(start + 1, len(states) + 1):
                expected_scores.append(
                    states[start] @ w["span_heads"][0]
                    + states[end - 1] @ w["span_heads"][1]
                    + states[start:end].mean(axis=0) @ w["span_heads"][2]
                )
    f = model._forward(query, inventory)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(f["scores"], expected_scores, atol=1e-14, rtol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(f["hidden"], expected_states, atol=1e-14, rtol=1e-13)
    expected_stop = np.mean(expected_states, axis=0) @ w["stop_head"] + w["stop_bias"][0]
    assert f["stop_logit"] == pytest.approx(expected_stop, abs=1e-14)

    np.testing.assert_allclose(f["hidden"], model._forward(query, original)["hidden"], atol=1e-14)


def test_conventional_attention_full_parameter_directional_gradients():
    from humanbrain.conventional_attention_reader import ConventionalAttentionReader

    query, inventory = _rate_cell_synthetic_inputs()
    model = ConventionalAttentionReader()
    rng = np.random.default_rng(185)
    model._weights["attention_weights"] += rng.standard_normal((64, 64)) * 0.2
    model._weights["span_heads"] *= 30
    model._weights["stop_head"] *= 30
    epsilon = 1e-5
    for gold in (inventory.gold_indices(b"quiet silver river"), None):
        _, gradients, _ = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)
        assert np.linalg.norm(gradients["attention_weights"]) > 1e-7
        for name, weight in model._weights.items():
            direction = rng.standard_normal(weight.shape)
            direction /= np.linalg.norm(direction)
            original = weight.copy()
            model._weights[name] = original + epsilon * direction
            plus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights[name] = original - epsilon * direction
            minus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights[name] = original
            analytic = float(np.sum(gradients[name] * direction))
            assert analytic == pytest.approx((plus - minus) / (2 * epsilon), abs=2e-8, rel=1e-4)
        # Modality columns must backpropagate through both query and document roles.
        for index in ((4, 384), (7, 385), (13, 16)):

            model._weights["input_weights"][index] = original + epsilon
            plus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights["input_weights"][index] = original - epsilon
            minus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights["input_weights"][index] = original

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def magnitude(value):
    a = np.asarray(value)
    return {'shape':list(a.shape), 'l2':float(np.linalg.norm(a)), 'rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(a*a))) if a.size else 0.0, 'max_abs':float(np.max(np.abs(a))) if a.size else 0.0, 'mean':float(a.mean()) if a.size else 0.0}

            qdrive = f['query_input'] @ model._weights['input_weights'].T + model._weights['input_bias']

    np.testing.assert_array_equal(model._weights["attention_weights"], np.eye(64))
    w = model._weights
    q = np.array(
        [np.tanh(w["input_weights"] @ np.r_[v, 1, 0] + w["input_bias"]) for v in query.vectors]
    )
    expected_scores, expected_states = [], []
    for window in inventory.windows:
        states = []
        for vector in window.vectors:
            d = np.tanh(w["input_weights"] @ np.r_[vector, 0, 1] + w["input_bias"])
            logits = np.array([d @ w["attention_weights"] @ u / 8 for u in q])
            probabilities = np.exp(logits - logits.max())
            probabilities /= probabilities.sum()
            h = np.tanh(w["fusion_weights"] @ np.r_[d, probabilities @ q] + w["fusion_bias"])
            states.append(h)
        states = np.array(states)
        expected_states.extend(states)
        for start in range(len(states)):
            for end in range(start + 1, len(states) + 1):
                expected_scores.append(
                    states[start] @ w["span_heads"][0]
                    + states[end - 1] @ w["span_heads"][1]
                    + states[start:end].mean(axis=0) @ w["span_heads"][2]
                )
    f = model._forward(query, inventory)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(f["scores"], expected_scores, atol=1e-14, rtol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(f["hidden"], expected_states, atol=1e-14, rtol=1e-13)
    expected_stop = np.mean(expected_states, axis=0) @ w["stop_head"] + w["stop_bias"][0]
    assert f["stop_logit"] == pytest.approx(expected_stop, abs=1e-14)
    # Window boundaries constrain candidates, but cannot add recurrence to producer.
    np.testing.assert_allclose(f["hidden"], model._forward(query, original)["hidden"], atol=1e-14)

def test_conventional_attention_full_parameter_directional_gradients():
    from humanbrain.conventional_attention_reader import ConventionalAttentionReader

    query, inventory = _rate_cell_synthetic_inputs()
    model = ConventionalAttentionReader()
    rng = np.random.default_rng(185)
    model._weights["attention_weights"] += rng.standard_normal((64, 64)) * 0.2
    model._weights["span_heads"] *= 30
    model._weights["stop_head"] *= 30
    epsilon = 1e-5
    for gold in (inventory.gold_indices(b"quiet silver river"), None):
        _, gradients, _ = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)
        assert np.linalg.norm(gradients["attention_weights"]) > 1e-7
        for name, weight in model._weights.items():
            direction = rng.standard_normal(weight.shape)
            direction /= np.linalg.norm(direction)
            original = weight.copy()
            model._weights[name] = original + epsilon * direction
            plus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights[name] = original - epsilon * direction
            minus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights[name] = original
            analytic = float(np.sum(gradients[name] * direction))
            assert analytic == pytest.approx((plus - minus) / (2 * epsilon), abs=2e-8, rel=1e-4)
        # Modality columns must backpropagate through both query and document roles.
        for index in ((4, 384), (7, 385), (13, 16)):
            original = model._weights["input_weights"][index]
            model._weights["input_weights"][index] = original + epsilon
            plus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights["input_weights"][index] = original - epsilon
            minus = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)[0]
            model._weights["input_weights"][index] = original
            assert gradients["input_weights"][index] == pytest.approx(

            )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("clip", [1.0, 0.01])
def test_conventional_attention_learning_stop_masks_and_frozen_state(clip):
    from humanbrain.conventional_attention_reader import ConventionalAttentionReader

    query, inventory = _rate_cell_synthetic_inputs()
    gold = inventory.gold_indices(b"quiet silver river")
    model = ConventionalAttentionReader(gradient_clip_norm=clip)
    frozen = ConventionalAttentionReader(mode="frozen", gradient_clip_norm=clip)
    initial = frozen.checkpoint_arrays()
    for name, weight in model._weights.items():
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(weight, frozen._weights[name])
    _, gradients, _ = model.loss_and_gradients(query, inventory, gold)
    first = model.observe(query, inventory, gold)
    assert first["parameter_update_applied"]
    assert first["loss_after"] < first["before_objective"]["loss"]
    assert first["native_update_applied"] is False
    if clip == 0.01:
        assert 0 < first["clip_scale"] < 1
    for name, raw_gradient in gradients.items():
        g = raw_gradient * first["clip_scale"]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(model._first[name], 0.1 * g, atol=1e-15, rtol=1e-13)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(model._second[name], 0.001 * g**2, atol=1e-15, rtol=1e-13)
        expected = frozen._weights[name] - 0.001 * (0.1 * g / (1 - 0.9)) / (
            np.sqrt(0.001 * g**2 / (1 - 0.999)) + 1e-8
        )
        np.testing.assert_allclose(model._weights[name], expected, atol=1e-15, rtol=1e-13)
    warmed = model.checkpoint_arrays()
    second = model.observe(query, inventory, None)
    assert second["before"] == first["after"]
    assert second["loss_after"] < second["before_objective"]["loss"]
    assert second["adam_steps_after"]["span_heads"] == 1
    for prefix in ("weight_", "adam_first_", "adam_second_"):
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
            model.checkpoint_arrays()[prefix + "span_heads"], warmed[prefix + "span_heads"]
        )
    for target in (gold, None):
        receipt = frozen.observe(query, inventory, target)
        assert receipt["active_parameters"] == [] and not receipt["parameter_update_applied"]
        assert receipt["gradient_norm"] == 0
    for name, value in initial.items():
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(frozen.checkpoint_arrays()[name], value)
    parent = model.checkpoint_sha256
    prediction = model.predict(query, inventory)
    assert model.checkpoint_sha256 == parent
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        prediction.span_scores.setflags(write=True)

import hashlib
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'benchmarks/public_qa_preparation_v1.json'


def file_record(name, content=True):
    raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    value = {'path': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(raw)}
    if content:
        value['content'] = json.loads(raw) if name.endswith('.json') else raw.decode('utf-8')
    return value


def check_hash(name, expected):
    record = file_record(name, False)
    assert record['sha256'] == expected, (name, record['sha256'], expected)
    return record


def junit(name, expected, tests, failures):
    check_hash(name, expected)
    record = file_record(name)
    suite = ET.fromstring(record['content']).find('testsuite')
    assert int(suite.attrib['tests']) == tests
    assert int(suite.attrib['failures']) == failures
    assert int(suite.attrib['errors']) == 0
    record['summary'] = dict(suite.attrib)
    return record

    if OUT.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(OUT)
    data = file_record('.pytest-tmp/public-qa-selection-independent-qa.json')

    assert selection_data['source_custody_sha256'] == custody['sha256']
    assert selection_data['exclusions']['sha256'] == exclusions['sha256']
    assert len(exclusions['content']['records']) == 18583
    assert exclusions['content']['source_sha256'] == data['content']['source_sha256'] == custody['content']['sha256']
    original_dataset = check_hash('.knowledge-cache/public_qa/squad2/train-v2.0.json', custody['content']['sha256'])
